stories.title: Two Safety Recalls Parents Need to Know: GOPO Teething Toys & HARPPA Toddler Tower Stools [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
CPSC RECALL: GOPO Toys Pull String Teething Toys — ~70,410 units. Silicone strings can reach a child's throat. 3 incidents. Stop use now.

Cut strings, mark DESTROYED, email recalls@gopotoys.com for refund.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Second CPSC recall this week: HARPPA Nordi Toddler Tower Stool (Model HANS0002) — ~41,166 units. Can collapse; child can become entrapped in openings.

Free repair kit available. Contact HARPPA to get it.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

Earlier reports said Aug. 13 — that was incorrect. Check AcademyD20.org for bus routes.

stories.title: New Study: 4+ Hours of Screen Time Linked to 45% Higher Anxiety in Kids [TIER 2]

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
New study of 50,231 kids: 4+ hours/day of screens linked to 45% higher anxiety risk, 61% higher depression risk.

Biggest culprit: bedroom screens after 9 PM displacing sleep. Back-to-school is the right time to reset.

#COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
